body:
@Mach12 If you are using vuejs, I would advise you, for the moment to use our lower level JavaScript helper: https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js

It's basically what IS is wrapping in a widget API but if you are only looking at the raw results then you could use that.

We have a tutorial showing how to use it with jQuery: https://www.algolia.com/doc/search/instant-search/algoliahelperjs

Let me know how it goes.
